    def __init__(self, s):
        self.s = s
        self.pos = 0
        self.depth = 0
        self.n = len(s)
    
    def error(self, msg, pos=None):
        if pos is None:
            pos = self.pos
        raise JSONError(msg, pos)
    
    def skip_ws(self):
        while self.pos < self.n and self.s[self.pos] in ' \t\n\r':
            self.pos += 1
    
    def parse(self):
        self.skip_ws()
        if self.pos >= self.n:
            self.error("unexpected end of input")
        val = self.parse_value()
        self.skip_ws()
        if self.pos < self.n:
            self.error("trailing garbage")
        return val
    
    def parse_value(self):
        self.skip_ws()
        if self.pos >= self.n:
            self.error("unexpected end of input")
        c = self.s[self.pos]
        if c == '{':
            return self.parse_object()
        elif c == '[':
            return self.parse_array()
        elif c == '"':
            return self.parse_string()
        elif c == 't':
            return self.parse_true()
        elif c == 'f':
            return self.parse_false()
        elif c == 'n':
            return self.parse_null()
        elif c == '-' or c.isdigit():
            return self.parse_number()
        else:
            self.error(f"unexpected character {c!r}")
    
    def parse_object(self):
        self.depth += 1
        if self.depth > 500:
            self.error("maximum nesting depth exceeded", self.pos)
        self.pos += 1  # consume '{'
        result = {}
        self.skip_ws()
        if self.pos >= self.n:
            self.error("unexpected end of input")
        if self.s[self.pos] == '}':
            self.pos += 1
            self.depth -= 1
            return result
        while True:
            self.skip_ws()
            if self.pos >= self.n:
                self.error("unexpected end of input")
            if self.s[self.pos] != '"':
                self.error("expected string key")

            if self.pos >= self.n:

            if self.s[self.pos] != ':':

            self.pos += 1  # consume ':'
            val = self.parse_value()

                self.skip_ws()

                self.depth -= 1

            else:

def parse_number(self):
    start = self.pos
    s = self.s
    n = self.n
    
    # Optional minus
    if self.pos < n and s[self.pos] == '-':
        self.pos += 1
    
    # Integer part
    if self.pos >= n:
        self.error("unexpected end of input")
    c = s[self.pos]
    if c == '0':
        self.pos += 1
        # Next char must not be a digit

            self.error("leading zero", self.pos)
    elif '1' <= c <= '9':
        self.pos += 1
        while self.pos < n and s[self.pos].isdigit():
            self.pos += 1
    else:
        self.error("invalid number", self.pos)
    
    # Fraction part
    is_float = False
    if self.pos < n and s[self.pos] == '.':
        is_float = True
        self.pos += 1
        if self.pos >= n:
            self.error("unexpected end of input")
        if not s[self.pos].isdigit():
            self.error("expected digit after '.'", self.pos)
        while self.pos < n and s[self.pos].isdigit():
            self.pos += 1
    
    # Exponent part

        is_float = True
        self.pos += 1
        if self.pos < n and s[self.pos] in '+-':
            self.pos += 1
        if self.pos >= n:
            self.error("unexpected end of input")
        if not s[self.pos].isdigit():
            self.error("expected digit in exponent", self.pos)
        while self.pos < n and s[self.pos].isdigit():
            self.pos += 1
    
    text = s[start:self.pos]
    if is_float:
        return float(text)
    else:
        return int(text)
